recipePrompt.template:
You are an expert cook. I want to use up these foods I have at home:
{{ingredients}}

Suggest {{what}}: real dishes that actually exist (traditional or widely known), not invented ones. Use as many of the listed foods as possible; you may add basic pantry staples (salt, oil, pepper, garlic, flour, eggs…). If a food doesn't fit, you can leave it out.

Reply ONLY with a single valid JSON code block, with no text before or after, using exactly this structure:
{{schema}}

Rules:
- "difficulty" is one of: Easy, Medium, Hard.
- "time" is the total time, e.g. "25 min".
- "tag" is a single word, e.g. Starter, Main, Side, Dessert.
- "qty" is the amount for 2 people, e.g. "200 g".
- "steps" are the steps in order, one per item, without numbering.
- Write all text in English.
